programs.title: Strength Performance Program
programs.notes:
This is an evolved program. Only do this when you have done strength training before or have completed “My First Strength Program”.
Start each session with a proper warm-up and keep the exercises in the same order.
Each day is divided into three supersets of three exercises. Complete each superset before moving to the next one.
You may rest between exercises, but not between repetitions.
Choose a load you can finish all the repetitions with, but that is heavy enough that you couldn’t do more.
Do a proper cool-down afterwards to keep post-exercise stiffness to a minimum.

Rotate the ball and punch up.
Control the movement back to the start position.
Keep your weight in your heels.
Use a metronome as guidance for tempo.

programs.title: Flexibility and Mobility Program
programs.notes:
Don’t use this program as a warm-up before an important session.
Keep the exercises in the same order. Each day is divided into three supersets of exercises or stretches. Complete each superset before moving to the next one.
You may rest whenever you want.
Most exercises need control and focus, with full range of motion in all joints.
Stretches should feel uncomfortable, never painful.
Do a proper cool-down afterwards to keep post-exercise stiffness to a minimum.

notes: Don’t use your non-weight bearing leg.
